tracks.about: Every track of an era (or defining reference songs of a genre): key (checked against two sources where possible; c = confidence, alt = the other reading when sources split), tempo, meter and feel as sourced (many sites count half-time songs at double speed and 6/8 songs in eighth notes, so tempos are folded into the style's range when used), mood/vibe/theme/sound tags, a short description in our own words (no lyrics), and a plan per section in song order (key, energy, instruments, switch-ups). Section energy and which instruments play in which section are often the researcher's reading of credits and reviews; vocal ranges only where sheet music or Wikipedia states them. Researched 9 Nov 2026 (Hooktheory, Musicnotes, SongBPM, Tunebat, Wikipedia, reviews). A new song picks one of these (weighted by mood and vibe) and borrows its key, tempo, feel and section plan, never its melody or words.
